source.primary_witnesses: Aramaic DSS fragments (4Q201-4Q207; late 3rd c. BCE through 1st c. BCE) where preserved; Greek Akhmim Panopolitanus (6th c. CE) where Aramaic absent; Ge'ez (medieval; the only complete witness) as fallback
source.transliteration_convention: Scholarly conventions: Aramaic Imperial-Aramaic transliteration per Milik 1976 (ḥ ṣ ʿ ḫ); Greek SBL convention (η→ē, ω→ō, θ→th, etc., matching Matthew precedent); Ge'ez SBL Ge'ez convention (ḫ ḫ̣ ʾ ʿ ä for ä-vowel)
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Milik 1976 DJD apparatus + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia + original codicology
source.fetchedFrom: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch + Black 1985 Greek text + Charles 1912 Ge'ez PD + Knibb 1978 Ge'ez critical edition + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia commentary
source.citation: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch (Oxford); Black 1985 The Book of Enoch or 1 Enoch (SVTP 7, Leiden); Nickelsburg 2001 1 Enoch 1 Hermeneia; Charles 1912 The Book of Enoch (Oxford, PD); Knibb 1978 The Ethiopic Book of Enoch (Oxford); Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 DJD XXXVI; VanderKam 1984 Enoch and the Growth of an Apocalyptic Tradition.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 29 — AROMATIC TREES OF JUDGMENT — Aramaic 4Q206 1 xx-xxi partial; Greek Akhmim 29:1-2 complete; Ge'ez full.

verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ἀπῆλθον εἰς ἄλλον τόπον ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, καὶ ἐχωρίσθην ἀνατολικώτερον τοῦ ὄρους τούτου.
verses.translit: Kai ekeithen apēlthon eis allon topon en tē erēmō, kai echōristhēn anatolikōteron tou orous toutou.
verses.text_geez: ወእምህየ፡ ሖርኩ፡ ውስተ፡ ካልእ፡ መካን፡ ውስተ፡ ገዳም፡ ወተፈለጥኩ፡ ጽባሕተ፡ እምነዝ፡ ደብር፡
verses.notes: Further east from the mountain — into wilderness territory.

verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἐκεῖ εἶδον δένδρα κρίσεως ἀπεκπνέοντα, καὶ ἐκεῖ μάλιστα τὰ δένδρα τὰ ἀρώματα τοῦ λιβάνου καὶ τῆς σμύρνης, καὶ τὰ δένδρα οὐχ ὅμοια ἦν.
verses.translit: Kai ekei eidon dendra kriseōs apekpneonta, kai ekei malista ta dendra ta arōmata tou libanou kai tēs smyrnēs, kai ta dendra ouch homoia ēn.
verses.text_geez: ወህየ፡ ርእኩ፡ ዕፀወ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ዘይትነፍሥ፡ ወህየ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ ዕፀዊሁ፡ ዘሕብለ፡ ስኂን፡ ወከርቤ፡ ወዕፀው፡ ኢተማሰሉ፡
verses.witness_secondary: 4Q206 1 xx partial (Milik 1976 pp. 230-232) — Aramaic of aromatic trees partial
verses.notes: **Trees of judgment exhaling [fragrance], frankincense, and myrrh trees.** The 'trees of judgment' is a curious phrase — likely 'trees of discernment' or 'spice-trees set apart for sacred use'. Cross-corpus: Exod 30:23-25 (the holy anointing oil with myrrh + cinnamon + cassia); the wise-men's frankincense and myrrh (Mt 2:11).
